text:
acme-eng: Hey, after upgrading @redwood/inference-sdk to v1.3.0 our Vite build started failing in prod builds with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. It worked on v1.2.3.

acme-eng: Build error snippet:
```
Error: Cannot find package '.../node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk' imported from .../src/main.ts
Caused by: Error [ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED]: No "exports" main defined for package '.../node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk'
    at new NodeError (internal/errors.js:xxx)
```

jamie (support): Sorry about that — can you paste your package.json and vite/webpack config? Also which node and npm/yarn versions?

acme-eng: package.json (relevant parts):
```json
{
  "name": "acme-frontend",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference-sdk": "^1.3.0"
  }
}
```
and vite 4, node 18.14.0. We import like: `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'`

jamie (support): Thanks. Two quick questions: are you bundling for the browser (Vite) or SSR? And does pinning back to 1.2.3 make the error go away?

acme-eng: Browser bundle. Yes pinning to 1.2.3 builds fine.

miguel (eng): Sounds like an exports map / ESM/CJS packaging regression we introduced in 1.3.0. Probably we added an exports map that only exposes the ESM entry, which breaks require/legacy bundlers and causes ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

sara (devex): Common repro: devs with "type":"module" + Vite expect package exports to include both import and require conditions plus explicit "./package.json" and types. If exports only has "./": "./dist/esm/index.js" then many bundlers error.

miguel (eng): Can you try a quick local change to node_modules to confirm? In node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/package.json change exports to something like:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./*": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/*.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/*.js"
  }
}
```
If that fixes your build, it confirms the packaging bug.

acme-eng: Tried that patch locally and build succeeds. Thanks.

jamie (support): Workarounds until we ship a patch: 1) Pin to @redwood/inference-sdk@1.2.3, 2) Add a Vite alias to force CJS entry: `resolve.alias = { '@redwood/inference-sdk': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/cjs/index.js' }`, or 3) patch node_modules as Miguel suggested. Not great but usable.

miguel (eng): We'll cut a patch release (v1.3.1) to revert the exports change and include both import/require conditions + types. Also add a test for Vite/webpack to CI.

deploy-bot: release v1.3.1 published to npm (dist-tag: latest) — includes exports fix and types entry. :shipit:

acme-eng: Confirmed — upgraded to v1.3.1 and prod build succeeds. Thanks everyone! :pray:

jamie (support): Marking this as resolved. We'll follow up with release notes and a short rollback postmortem explaining root cause (exports-only ESM exposure and missing require condition).

miguel (eng): Adding test coverage item to backlog and will open a small PR to verify dual-condition exports for future releases.

sara (devex): I'll update docs and add a short note in the SDK migration guide about Node/bundler quirks and recommended package.json fields for consumers.

acme-eng: Appreciate the quick turnaround.
